evidence_boundary: Repository reconstructed scorer with SciPy Hungarian matching; public training examples, not official server or unseen competition-test scores. Verification samples were not used for this round of candidate development; prior model-training overlap is not excluded.
fusion_evidence_kind: Compatibility check using saved intermediates from each same-chain run; external-model, iterate and cropfix paths disabled. Not a fresh full fusion-enabled image run or VLM-enabled validation.

validation_policy.selection_policy: Equal fixed style quotas per group; positive box-pin count; balanced within-style image-area thirds and box-pin-count bins; deterministic SHA256 tiebreak; exclude both PNG-byte and decoded-RGB duplicates of official10 and among public candidates.
validation_policy.verification_policy: Use verification GT for final evaluation only after candidate code is fixed; selection reads schema/counts, not pin values or prediction losses.

existing_image_boundary_issues.evidence_boundary: Strict containment is an extra acceptance check, not established as an official scoring contract; all listed containment failures also occur in baseline. Predictions were not changed.
